info.title: OpenVibe.Today API
info.description: Routes of OpenVibe.Today as the OpenVibe contracts describe them (openvibe-contracts 0.270.0): each operation lists the capabilities it performs; a token for the service's audience must carry one of them unless the route is open. Generated by openvibe-contracts lib/openapi.js; do not edit.

get.summary: Set, list, snooze, stop and remove a person's own reminders on OpenVibe.Today, for that person (plan L48): a first-party service such as OpenVibe.Chat's Vibe names the person with X-OV-Subject, and ev
get.description: **today.reminder.write** (first-party): Set, list, snooze, stop and remove a person's own reminders on OpenVibe.Today, for that person (plan L48): a first-party service such as OpenVibe.Chat's Vibe names the person with X-OV-Subject, and every route answers only that person's reminders. A reminder is plain words parsed by Today ("stretch every 2 hours from 9 to 5") and keeps the https link and the source site that set it.

errors.problem.v1.title: Problem
errors.problem.v1.description: RFC 9457 problem details (application/problem+json) with a stable OpenVibe error code and trace identifiers. The legacy 'error' string is allowed during migration so existing clients keep working.

error.description: Deprecated compatibility field: same text as title/detail for clients that read {error}.

today.reminder-request.v1.title: TodayReminderRequest
today.reminder-request.v1.description: today.reminder-request@1: the body of POST /api/v1/reminders and POST /api/v1/reminders/parse on OpenVibe.Today (today.reminder.write; the acting person). The reminder is plain words, parsed by Today into a rule in the person's time zone ("stretch every 2 hours from 9 to 5", "take my meds every day at 9 am and 9 pm", "pay rent on the 1st of every month"). POST /api/v1/reminders/:id/snooze takes { minutes } alone.

text.description: What to remind the person of, and when, in their own words.

tz.description: The person's IANA time zone (America/Chicago); an unknown zone is read as UTC.

url.description: Where the reminder came from: an https link kept on it and opened from the notification. Anything else is dropped.

source.description: The site that set it (vibe, live, work…), shown to the person.

minutes.description: Snooze only: how long, from now.

today.reminder-result.v1.title: TodayReminderResult
today.reminder-result.v1.description: today.reminder-result@1: answers of the reminder routes on OpenVibe.Today. POST /api/v1/reminders/parse → a preview (title, rule, tz, next_at, summary); POST /api/v1/reminders, /:id/done and /:id/snooze → one reminder; GET /api/v1/reminders → { reminders }. A refusal is 422 { error } in words the person can act on ("Say when: …").

summary.description: The rule in words: "Every 2 hours, 9 am–5 pm".

rule.description: once { at } | daily { times, days? } | interval { minutes, from?, to?, days?, start? } | monthly { day, time }

openvibeToken.description: An OpenVibe Network token for this service: a person's token, an app token (client credentials, audience of the service) or a first-party service token. Its `cap` claim must include the capability the operation names.
